name: GalaAuctionManager
tagline: Check-in, seating, silent and live auction, paddle raise and checkout – the whole gala night in one app.
description: A complete fundraising gala app for nonprofits in one PCF control: guest check-in with paddle numbers, a drag-and-drop table plan that keeps parties together, silent auction sections and live lots with bid rules, buy-now and hammer prices, a paddle raise / fund-a-need thermometer with level-by-level entry, and checkout with payments, receipts, tax-deductible estimates and net revenue KPIs.
features: Check-in with automatic paddle numbers and card on file
Table capacity, seat numbers, party split warning and Seat party together
Bid increments, starting bids, no self-outbidding, bid jump confirmation
Buy-now, hammer prices for live lots, close a silent section in one step
Retract last bid, reopen and withdraw lots with reasons
Paddle raise levels with multi-paddle entry and validation
Checkout with partial payments, card on file, invoice and item hand-over
Receipt text with estimated tax-deductible amount (ReceiptText output)
Net revenue after item and event costs, collected vs outstanding
controlType: standard (2 controls: GalaAuctionManager data-set, GalaAuctionManagerPortal field)
